name: Spindle Thread
description: Spin a spindle of soul force that unwinds a thread whenever a soul moves within its reach.

name: Cleft Noose
description: Open a cleft noose of soul force that tightens round a target's will as it reaches out.

name: Bright Barb
description: Throw a bright barb of soul force at a soul that has crossed the thread.

name: Hindering Tether
description: Tether a target's will to a fixed point of soul force so it cannot range far.

name: Reeled Cord
description: Reel a line of soul force tight to a mark and let it pull the body clear of a strike.

name: Stitched Guard
description: Stitch layered threads of soul force about the self to withstand repeated mental blows.

name: Snapping Maw
description: Plant a maw of soul force in open air that snaps shut on any soul entering it and grinds.

name: Fouling Thread
description: Lay a thread of soul force that leaves a creeping stain on each soul passing and weakens its techniques.

name: Azure Gaol
description: Raise a great cage of soul force that holds every soul inside it until the user lets it fall.

name: Lattice Listening
description: Listen along a lattice of soul force for the tremor of a soul that has stepped upon it.

name: Twin Cinch
description: Close twin cinches of soul force on both of a target's arms at once.

name: Paired Barb
description: Send two small barbs of soul force down paired lines into one soul.

name: Twofold Guard
description: Fold two layers of soul force about the self so a push must break both.

name: Opposed Pull
description: Pull two lines of soul force against each other inside a target's gathered technique and tear it.

name: Matched Lock
description: Lock two matched seals of soul force on a target's will so it cannot free both at once.

name: Scissoring Cords
description: Cross two lines of soul force through a group so each soul between them is cut by both.

name: Twinned Lattice
description: Set two lattices of soul force one over the other so a soul freed from the first is caught by the second.

name: Mirrored Snare
description: Plant a snare of soul force in two halves that each close when either half is touched.

name: Twinhold Crush
description: Close both lattices of soul force on a held soul and press until its will bows.

name: Keen Tendril
description: Fix a watching thread of soul force on one point and feel any soul that stirs near it.

name: Soul Cuff
description: Close a cuff of soul force on a target's limb to stop its swing.

name: Claw Flick
description: Flick a claw of soul force across the soul of a target within reach.

name: Shackled Will
description: Shackle a target's will with soul force so its technique comes out weak and slow.

name: Dropping Cord
description: Drop a line of soul force from above and slide down it to land beside a target.

name: Pinion Shield
description: Spread pinions of soul force wide to take mental blows aimed at the self or a close ally.

name: Gaoler's Cage
description: Plant a cage of soul force that drops on the first soul to cross and holds it in plain sight.

name: Stooping Talons
description: Dive talons of soul force through the snare line into a caught soul and pierce its guard.

name: Unblinking Gaol
description: Keep a vast watching cage of soul force open that tightens on any soul trying to slip from sight.

name: Flow Perceiving
description: Read the current of soul force in a still basin and mark where a soul has disturbed its flow.

name: Reed Cinch
description: Wind a reed-thin cinch of soul force round a target's limb as it passes through the flow.

name: Eddy Barb
description: Turn an eddy of soul force into a barb that strikes the soul that stirred it.

name: Sluice Guard
description: Close a sluice of soul force over the self to shut out a flood of hostile intent.

name: Float Step
description: Float the body on a swell of soul force to cross a stride unseen.

name: Swelling Flow
description: Let a flow of soul force swell round a target and press its will down.

name: Drowning Cinch
description: Draw a cinch of soul force under a target as under deep water so its limbs sag and weigh.

name: Reversed Current
description: Turn the current of soul force against an incoming soul attack and carry it back.

name: Weir Snare
description: Lay a weir of soul force across open air that gathers every soul passing and holds them in its pool.

name: Silt Taint
description: Stir silt of soul force into the flow so any soul passing is clouded and slowed.

name: Opened Floodgate
description: Open the floodgate of held soul force so the whole basin pours over every soul within it.

name: Drift Wire
description: Let a wire of soul force drift on the air and read the tug of any soul that bumps it.

name: Windknot
description: Throw a knot of soul force on a gust so it closes round a target before it can turn.

name: Cutting Draught
description: Send a thin cutting draught of soul force through the soul of a target nearby.

name: Squall Cinch
description: Whip a cinch of soul force round a target in a squall and hold it while it spins.

name: Veering Cord
description: Veer the body on a cord of soul force round a strike and come out beside the foe.

name: Gale Diverting
description: Turn a gale of soul force across an incoming soul strike to throw it wide.

name: Gale Gin
description: Set a toothed gin of soul force on the air that clamps on a soul crossing its line.

name: Squalling Burr
description: Scatter burrs of soul force on the wind that cling to souls and drag at their focus.

name: Tempest of Threads
description: Raise a tempest of snare threads that whirls across a wide span and binds every soul it touches.

name: Clear Reading
description: Spread soul force clear and thin to read the gaps in the air that a hidden soul would leave.

name: Open Jaw
description: Hold a jaw of soul force wide open until a soul enters it and then close it.

name: Rake Barb
description: Rake a barb of soul force across the soul of a target that steps near the gin.

name: Sheer Cover
description: Pull a sheer sheet of soul force across a soul strike to slide it off the self.

name: Snapping Jaw
description: Snap a jaw of soul force shut on the soul of a target that comes within its bite.

name: Pinned Rush
description: Pin a rushing target's will with soul force so its charge falters mid-stride.

name: Tooth Spread
description: Spread teeth of soul force through a target's senses so it cannot trust where it stands.

name: Grand Gin
description: Plant a grand gin of soul force in open air with jaws wide enough to take a whole soul at once.

name: Raised Spring
description: Raise a field of sleeping springs of soul force that fire together when one is trod upon.

name: Sundering Jaws
description: Close jaws of soul force on a caught soul and bite through its defenses to wound its core directly.

name: Hold Reading
description: Hold a cord of soul force unbroken for a long while and feel any soul that strains it.

name: Unbroken Loop
description: Throw a loop of soul force that does not part however a target pulls.

name: Firm Barb
description: Drive a firm barb of soul force into a soul that strains the net.

name: Steadfast Mesh
description: Weave a steadfast mesh of soul force about the self that does not fray under mental blows.

name: Net Draw
description: Draw the body along a taut net line to a new footing.

name: Binding Weave
description: Weave a net of soul force round a target by degrees and hold the weave through its struggle.

name: Quelling Mesh
description: Press a mesh of soul force across a group so that each will in it sags.

name: Withheld Strike
description: Hold a strike of soul force in the net until a soul moves and then drive it through the guard.

name: Net Recoil
description: Let a hostile soul push strike the net and spring back along the line it came.

name: Unbroken Net
description: Raise a wide net of soul force that keeps its strands whole against every strain and holds all souls inside.

name: Sleeper's Net
description: Seed sleepers of soul force in open air that wake together and net every soul that stirs them.

name: Unyielding Weave
description: Bind a caught soul's every technique under a weave of soul force that cannot be loosed from inside.

name: Distant Hearing
description: Send soul force far out along a single thread and hear what stirs at its end.

name: Long Hitch
description: Throw a long hitch of soul force that closes on a target at the end of its reach.

name: Reach Barb
description: Throw a barb of soul force the whole length of a laid thread at a distant soul.

name: Reeling Cord
description: Reel a target in along a bound cord of soul force until it stands where the user chooses.

name: Truebearing Reach
description: Hold soul force true on a single bearing until a target walking into it slows and sags.

name: Far Cover
description: Throw a cover of soul force far in front of the self to bend a distant soul strike aside.

name: Distant Snare
description: Plant a snare of soul force at a far mark that closes on any soul reaching it.

name: Spanning Lattice
description: Stretch a lattice of soul force across a great span that holds any soul wandering into it.

name: Farthest Cinch
description: Cast a cinch of soul force across a vast span to close on a soul far beyond ordinary reach.
